finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If filePath contains a malicious path or filename, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The _rootDir variable is assumed to be a trusted directory path. The filePath variable is assumed to be attacker-controlled.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked if there are any checks on the filePath variable before it is used in File.WriteAllText. Found that the filePath is combined with _rootDir using Path.Combine, which should prevent directory traversal attacks. Additionally, the filePath is not directly used in any command execution, so there is no risk of OS command injection.
